[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Tangle Root | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=048 }} [[Tangle Root]] is a large area towards the south of the [[Maguuma Jungle]] which borders the concealed [[Henge of Denravi]]. The eastern part of this zone is a confusing layout of water-filled canyons crossed above by thick wooden trunks, and is home to numerous [[Jungle Troll|trolls]] and [[Jungle Skale|skale]]. ==Getting there== Exit from Henge of Denravi or travel through [[Ettin's Back]] and [[Dry Top]] from [[Ventari's Refuge]]. The [[primary quest]] [[Passage Through The Dark River]] will lead you through here. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s: * Northeast, near the exit to [[Henge of Denravi]]. * West, near the exit to [[Dry Top]]. ;[[Statue of Melandru]] * Southeast corner. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== ====Services==== *[[Orson Cooper]] ([[collector]] for [[Ancient Eye]]s) *[[Serah Shaes]] (collector for [[Jungle Skale Fin]]s) *[[Tully Blackvine]] (collector for [[Tangled Seed]]s) *[[Artisan Orpah]] ([[artisan]]) *[[Old Joness]] - Talk to Old Joness to be taken to [[Riverside Province (outpost)|Riverside Province]] *[[Melandru#Melandru_statues|Statue of Melandru]] located in the Southeast corner of the map, next to Old Joness. ===Charmable animals=== [[Animal]]s * {{x}} 5 (5) [[Warthog]] ===Foes=== [[Behemoth]]s * {{w}} 19 (25) [[Root Behemoth]] [[Plant]]s * {{r}} 19 (25) [[Redwood Shepherd]] * {{Mo}} 15 (25) [[Life Pod]] * {{E}} 17 (25) [[Thorn Stalker]] [[Rider]]s * {{Me}} 17 (25) [[Wind Rider (Maguuma Jungle)|Wind Rider]] [[Scarab]]s * {{N}} 16 (25) [[Moss Scarab]] [[Skale]]s * {{N}} 19 (25) [[Jungle Skale]] [[Troll]]s * {{W}}{{r}} 14 (24), 18 (25) [[Jungle Troll]] ====Bosses==== [[Plant]]s * {{r}} 20 (29) [[Tree of Memories]] * {{mo}} 20 (29) [[Tree of Regrowth]] [[Skale]]s * {{n}} 20 (29) [[Nalle the Webbed]] * {{me}} 20 (29) [[Snap the Braineater]] * {{e}} 20 (29) [[Falls the Fishfinder]] [[Troll]]s * {{w}} 20 (29) [[Marrg Grummbool]] ==Notes== {{gw2w}} * Lone [[Jungle Troll]]s may be accompanied by a pair of hidden [[Life Pod]]s and, rarely, a few [[Moss Scarab]]s. * Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.71% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title. ** There are (at least) three ways to reach the upper pathways of Tangle Root: *** Turn at your first left uphill after leaving Henge of Denravi. *** Turn right after leaving Maguuma Stade. *** Turn north uphill by Old Joness and the Statue of Melandru. *{{Vanquisher|count = 210|low = 191|high = 239}} ** There a lot of hidden [[Moss Scarab]]s and [[Life Pod]]s. ** The count increases slightly during [[Defend Denravi]].
